service_boundary: Represents SambaNova Cloud's developer API, not SambaNova on-premises systems, model publishers, or third-party gateways exposing SambaNova endpoints.
regional_controls: The reviewed public cloud documentation does not establish customer-selected inference regions; private and on-premises offerings are separate boundaries.
retention_controls: Request handling follows SambaNova's cloud terms and account arrangements; the reviewed public docs do not support a universal configurable retention claim.
routing: Customers select models hosted by SambaNova rather than unrelated upstream providers.
customization: Reserved and private capacity arrangements are enterprise paths; arbitrary public customer-weight upload is not claimed here.
strengths: OpenAI-compatible access simplifies adoption of its hosted model catalog.
SambaNova-operated infrastructure provides a distinct accelerator path.
tradeoffs: The hosted catalog and public regional controls are limited compared with hyperscale clouds.
Private deployment capabilities belong to separate commercial arrangements.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the documentation or on the public trust centre.
response_integrity.scope: SambaNova trust centre, read for SambaNova Cloud

upstream_disclosure.note: A company blog post states "SambaCloud never sees or collects any of your data or user prompts ensuring full data privacy.", which is a marketing claim rather than a description of who processes API content; the privacy policy does not address API inputs, and no data-processing addendum or subprocessor list describing the inference path was readable. The public trust centre carries a subprocessor list behind a request-access control.
upstream_disclosure.scope: SambaNova security blog post, read for SambaNova Cloud

credential_handling.note: The API offers no customer-supplied-key path: "To generate an API key, go to the API section of the SambaCloud portal." and every documented request uses that key.
credential_handling.scope: SambaNova Cloud API-keys page, for SambaNova Cloud

cache_isolation.note: The prompt-caching announcement describes the feature and its pricing but never states whether a cache is scoped to the account that created it.
cache_isolation.scope: SambaNova prompt-caching blog post, for SambaNova Cloud

vulnerability_disclosure.note: The public trust centre publishes a security contact, security@sambanovasystems.com.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: SambaNova trust centre, for SambaNova Cloud

independent_audit.note: The operator's security blog post names the service: "SambaCloud is also SOC 2 Type 2 compliant and certified." The public trust centre states the company holds SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 certifications, with reports behind a request-access control.
independent_audit.scope: SambaNova security blog post, for SambaNova Cloud
